content.summary: Accept this exact manuscript within its stated local formal-assurance scope. I reread the final claims and performed a fresh exhaustive numerical challenge rather than inheriting a vote. Both frozen hashes match. No required revision or open major finding remains in my review.

checks.scope: Final four-star grid and strength of resulting conclusion
checks.method: Compared the final formula/domain with SupportGrid53.lean and independently enumerated every weakly decreasing quadruple from 0 through 19 using exact integers.
checks.observation: The enumeration covers 8,855 tuples, retains exactly 6,031 admissible tuples, and gives unique maximum 4475 at (19,14,13,13), thirteen below 4488. This checks a numerical relaxation, not a family enumeration. The final manuscript correctly combines it with separate combinatorial bridges, retains the repaired small-L cases, and describes support53 plus an I(27) equivalence without asserting finite exclusion, sharpness, or a new extremal value. Cached third-party dependencies and nonindependent review remain disclosed. Committed presentation repairs introduce no stronger mathematical claim.
